title: Sharp handheld photos
summary: Settings and stance that stop camera shake.

items: Lowest ISO that still gives a safe shutter speed.
Shutter at least **1/focal length**, or use a tripod.
Right hand grips, left hand cradles the lens from below.
Feet shoulder-width apart, one slightly forward.
Kneeling: rest your elbow on your knee.
Lean on a wall, post or tree.
Breathe out, then press the shutter gently.

blocks.text: Rough guide only. Results vary with camera, lens and your hands.
